mapper.select: SELECT username, password, name, role, email, phone, postcode, road_address, jibun_address, detail_address, created_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( username, password, name, role, email, phone, postcode, road_address, jibun_address, detail_address, created_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{postcode}, #{roadAddress}, #{jibunAddress}, #{detailAddress}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, postcode = #{postcode}, road_address = #{roadAddress}, jibun_address = #{jibunAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
